title: Build the visible-lobby directory and code/passcode join flow
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement Multiplayer entry from public directory DTOs: meaningful empty/loading/failure states, distinct public lobby items, Create a lobby and Join with code. Do not wrap the whole directory in a mother glass card or repeat the logo. A private/invisible lobby is entered only via an explicit short-code flow; passcode is requested only when the approved join contract requires it. Alias/avatar remain editable through callbacks before joining. Never list passcodes, hashes, private membership or hidden lobbies. Directory selection/code submit express join intent and wait for authority. Declare this presentation module readonly props locally from the documented fields and accept injected callbacks/asset lookups; do not import an unfinished server implementation. A035/A048 adapt canonical production DTOs and parsed intents into these props.
acceptance: Visible directory and empty state explain what can be done; create opens configuration instead of creating an opaque default room.
Code/passcode entry validates approved forms, masks sensitive input and never stores/logs or includes it in public error text.
Private/invisible lobbies and passcode/hash fields cannot leak through directory DOM, attributes or accessible labels.
Loading, full-room, wrong-code/passcode and safe recovery states preserve keyboard focus and the background modal lock.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: 5. Multiplayer entry; VISUAL-SYSTEM: directorio de lobbies
